title: Scholarship Opportunity Finder
shortDescription: A student-built resource to make legitimate scholarships, grants, and other funding opportunities easier to discover and understand.
fullDescription: Students are working toward a Scholarship Opportunity Finder that makes funding opportunities easier to discover, compare, and understand. The team will decide what form the resource should take as the project develops.
commitment: Plan for approximately 3–5 hours a week over six weeks. That time may include independent work, team communication, research, building, and meetings. The exact workload may vary; what matters is contributing consistently.
problemHeading: Finding funding should be less frustrating.
problem: Scholarship and grant information is scattered across websites that can feel overwhelming or spam-heavy. Students may not know where to look, what they qualify for, or whether information is current and legitimate.
approachHeading: The solution is the team's to shape.
whatWeAreBuilding: The team will research and verify opportunities, organize the information, design a student-friendly experience, and build a resource students can use. It might become a searchable database, website tool, matching system, or another format the team finds more useful. None of those formats has been decided yet.
whyItMatters: A clearer resource could save students time and help them discover opportunities they might otherwise miss. FYM also wants to be able to maintain and improve the work after the sprint.
goal: The goal is to finish the sprint with a publicly usable resource: organized opportunities, verified information, an intuitive way to find them, and a way for FYM to keep the information current. The team will determine the right technical solution.

contributionAreas.name: Technology / Development
contributionAreas.description: Help turn the team's solution into a working digital resource.
tasks: Choose suitable technology with the team
Build the digital product and, if useful, search, filtering, matching, or database features
Test and improve functionality

contributionAreas.name: Research & Data
contributionAreas.description: Make the information trustworthy and useful.
tasks: Find legitimate scholarships and grants; check eligibility, deadlines, award amounts, requirements, and official links
Organize and verify information using reliable sources
Help establish a way to keep opportunities updated

contributionAreas.name: UI/UX Design
contributionAreas.description: Make the resource easy for students to use.
tasks: Design layouts, interfaces, and a clear visual system
Decide how students should navigate and compare opportunities
Test with students and improve the experience

contributionAreas.name: Writing
contributionAreas.description: Make funding information easier to understand.
tasks: Write clear descriptions of opportunities
Create useful guides and explanations
Help turn complicated requirements into accessible language

contributionAreas.name: Product / Operations
contributionAreas.description: Help the team work together and keep the resource useful.
tasks: Organize the project and coordinate work across areas
Help define how the resource should work
Set up a process for maintaining scholarship information

contributionAreas.name: Outreach & People
contributionAreas.description: Bring student perspectives into the project.
tasks: Learn what students need from a scholarship resource
Gather feedback and help test the product with potential users
Help share the finished resource

sprint.name: Research & Understand
sprint.description: Understand the problem before choosing a solution.
tasks: Research existing solutions and student pain points
Define who the resource should help and what it should accomplish
Divide initial responsibilities

sprint.name: Research & Plan
sprint.description: Set standards and plan the first version.
tasks: Begin collecting opportunities and verifying sources and requirements
Organize initial data consistently
Finalize the product plan

sprint.name: Build
sprint.description: Turn research into something students can use.
tasks: Create the resource or tool
Organize opportunity information
Build and design the core experience

sprint.name: Test
sprint.description: Try the first version with students outside the team.
tasks: Find confusing, missing, inaccurate, or difficult parts
Check links and information
Collect feedback

sprint.name: Improve
sprint.description: Focus on what the feedback reveals.
tasks: Improve design and usability
Continue verifying information
Fix problems and prepare the next version

sprint.name: Finish & Publish
sprint.description: Bring the work together for students to use.
tasks: Complete final checks and work toward publication
Prepare materials to share the resource
Document how FYM can maintain it after the sprint
